sentences.text: Marvel 's Iron Fist , or simply Iron Fist , is an American web television series created for Netflix by Scott Buck , based on the Marvel Comics character of the same name .	Scott Buck	Scott Buck	Iron Fist	Iron Fist (comics)	Netflix	Netflix	web television	web television	Marvel Comics	Marvel Comics	of the same name	Iron Fist (comics)

It is set in the Marvel Cinematic Universe -LRB- MCU -RRB- , sharing continuity with the films of the franchise and is the fourth in a series of shows that will lead up to The Defenders crossover miniseries .	Marvel Cinematic Universe	Marvel Cinematic Universe	the films of the franchise	List of Marvel Cinematic Universe films	series of shows	List of Marvel Cinematic Universe television series#Netflix series	The Defenders	The Defenders (miniseries)

The series is produced by Marvel Television in association with ABC Studios and Devilina Productions , with Buck serving as showrunner .	Marvel Television	Marvel Television	ABC Studios	ABC Studios	showrunner	showrunner
Finn Jones stars as Danny Rand / Iron Fist , a martial arts expert with the ability to call upon the power of the Iron Fist .	Iron Fist	Iron Fist (comics)	Finn Jones	Finn Jones

Jessica Henwick , Tom Pelphrey , Jessica Stroup , Ramón Rodríguez , Sacha Dhawan , Rosario Dawson and David Wenham also star .	Jessica Henwick	Jessica Henwick	Tom Pelphrey	Tom Pelphrey	Jessica Stroup	Jessica Stroup	Ramón Rodríguez	Ramón Rodríguez (actor)	Sacha Dhawan	Sacha Dhawan	Rosario Dawson	Rosario Dawson	David Wenham	David Wenham

After a film based on the character spent over a decade in development at Marvel Studios , development for the series began in late 2013 at Marvel Television , with Buck hired as the series showrunner in December 2015 and Jones cast as Rand in February 2016 .	Marvel Television	Marvel Television	showrunner	showrunner	Marvel Studios	Marvel Studios
Filming began in New York City in April 2016 and concluded in October 2016 .	New York City	New York City

Iron Fist had its premiere on March 15 , 2017 , in New York City , with the full season of 13 episodes releasing on Netflix on March 17 , 2017 .	Iron Fist	Iron Fist (comics)	New York City	New York City	Netflix	Netflix

The series received mixed reviews from critics , with criticism aimed towards its pace and storytelling , underwhelming fight sequences , and Jones ' portrayal of Rand , while Henwick 's performance as Colleen Wing and the appearances of established characters Claire Temple and Jeri Hogarth received praise .	Colleen Wing	Colleen Wing	Claire Temple	Claire Temple (Marvel Cinematic Universe)	Jeri Hogarth	Jeryn Hogarth
Third-party data analytics determined the series had strong initial viewership , but this was shortly cut in half .
